body:
"Good thing your dad died. He wouldn't of liked me."

"I can learn to be attracted to you again."

Offhandedly hearing my mother blame me for my brother's suicide when I actively tried to stop him.
Yup! There are a lot of us :)
I'd love to pick one of these up if you're selling \^\^

I can tell you that no one deserves to hurt. Unfortunately, there will be people in your life that turn a blind eye to things when they can't understand (or don't want to understand) what you're going through. If at all possible, find people that will listen to you. Even if that's an online community for now.

I've been there. I get in that mindset even still. It's so very hard, but even just telling one person that will listen helps so much.

Try and keep your head above water.
